title: 第二十章 朝堂惊雷起，储位一朝倾
content_zh:
天色微曦，破晓的微光破开层层夜色，洒在紫禁城巍峨的琉璃瓦上。长长的宫道肃静深沉，文武百官身着朝服，依次踏过金水桥，步履间皆带着几分难言的凝重。

    昨夜朝中便暗流涌动，人人皆知，被禁足东宫的太子并未安分守己，反而暗中联络一众亲信朝臣，打算在今日早朝发难，矛头直指丞相沈敬山。

    金銮殿内，龙涎香缭绕不散，肃穆的气氛压得人喘不过气。景帝端坐龙椅之上，神色沉静，眼底藏着审视，静静等候百官启奏。

    百官列立两班，无人率先出声，殿内只剩轻微的衣料摩擦声响。

    片刻沉寂后，太子派系的几名御史率先跨步出列，手捧奏折，朗声直言。

    “启禀陛下！丞相沈敬山治家不严，后宅积弊十余年未曾彻查，纵容嫡女私查旧案、联动官府，逾越闺阁本分，干预外事！且丞相身居高位多年，门生故吏遍布朝野，隐隐有权重盖主、结党营私之嫌，恳请陛下彻查追责，以正朝纲！”

    一人话音落下，紧随其后，五六名提前串通好的官员接连出列附和，句句堆砌罪名，字字刻意诛心，将一桩寻常后宅旧案，硬生生扭曲成朝堂祸乱的由头。

    殿内气氛瞬间凝滞。

    立于皇子队列中的萧景煜，垂在身侧的手指微微收紧，眼底藏着压抑多日的阴鸷与得意。

    他如今后宅无棋可用，便转战朝堂。只要借着权柄过重的由头扳倒沈敬山，没了丞相府的支撑，没了朝堂势力的依仗，沈清鸢纵然心思再缜密、手段再凌厉，也不过是个无依无靠的深闺女子，任由他拿捏。

    沈敬山神色坦荡，稳步出列，躬身叩首，字字铿锵有力。

    “陛下明鉴。臣府中旧案乃是沉冤十余年的冤案，近日人证物证俱全，交由官府依法处置，全程循规蹈矩，从未私动权势、搅动朝局。小女为亡母洗雪冤屈，恪守本心，从未干预朝堂分毫。臣为官三十余载，一心为公、恪尽职守，从未结党营私、徇私枉法，还请陛下明察。”

    他句句属实，条理清晰，坦荡无愧，可太子党羽早已串通一气，纷纷出言辩驳，颠倒黑白，朝堂之上瞬间争执四起，句句都在刻意抹黑沈家。

    景帝眉头微蹙，面色渐渐沉了下来。

    就在喧闹最盛之时，一道清冷低沉的嗓音骤然响起，瞬间压过满殿嘈杂。

    “诸位大人这番颠倒黑白的说辞，未免太过牵强。”

    萧聿辞缓步从宗室队列走出，玄色绣金龙朝服衬得他身姿挺拔卓然，眉眼覆着一层寒霜，周身威压慑人。他立于大殿正中，目光淡淡扫过一众叫嚣的官员，只一眼，方才还喋喋不休的众人瞬间噤声垂首，不敢多言半句。

    紧随其后，两名黑衣暗卫躬身入殿，捧着厚厚一叠装订整齐的卷宗，稳稳铺在殿前御案旁。

    “臣有证呈上。”萧聿辞声音冷冽，响彻整座金銮殿，“此为近半年东宫私结朝臣、暗收地方贿赂、私蓄死士的全部记录，另有太子禁足期间，数次传递密信、操纵言官、蓄意构陷肱骨重臣的亲笔信札铁证。”
content_en:
The sky was slightly bright, and the gleam of dawn broke through the layers of night and shone on the towering glazed tiles of the Forbidden City.The long palace road was solemn and deep. All the civil and military officials, dressed in court uniforms, stepped across the Jinshui Bridge one by one, with a bit of unspeakable solemnity in their steps.

There was an undercurrent in the court last night. Everyone knew that the prince, who was banned from the East Palace, did not keep his peace. Instead, he secretly contacted a group of trusted court officials and planned to launch an attack in the court today, targeting Prime Minister Shen Jingshan.

In the Jinluan Hall, the scent of ambergris lingered, and the solemn atmosphere made people breathless.Emperor Jing was sitting on the dragon chair with a calm look on his face, eyes hidden with scrutiny, quietly waiting for the officials to start playing.

Hundreds of officials lined up in two groups, but no one took the lead to make a sound. There was only a slight sound of clothing rubbing together in the hall.

After a moment of silence, several censors from the prince's faction took the lead in stepping out of the queue, holding memorials in their hands and speaking out loud.

"Your Majesty! Prime Minister Shen Jingshan has been lax in running the family. He has not thoroughly investigated the malpractice in the harem for more than ten years. He has allowed his legitimate daughter to investigate old cases secretly, cooperate with the government, go beyond the duties of the boudoir, and interfere in foreign affairs! In addition, the Prime Minister has been in a high position for many years, and his disciples and former officials are all over the government and the public. He is suspected of being powerful and trying to cover up his master and forming cliques for personal gain. I sincerely request your Majesty to thoroughly investigate and hold him accountable, so as to set the right direction for the government!"

After one person finished speaking, five or six officials who had colluded in advance came out to echo one after another. They piled up accusations every sentence, and deliberately made every word heart-breaking, twisting an ordinary old case in the back house into the cause of chaos in the court.

The atmosphere in the hall suddenly became stagnant.

Xiao Jingyu, who was standing in the queue of princes, tightened his fingers hanging by his side slightly, and his eyes contained the sinister lust and pride that had been suppressed for many days.

Now that he had no chess to play at home, he turned to the court.As long as Shen Jingshan is overthrown with excessive power, without the support of the Prime Minister's Office and the reliance of the court's power, Shen Qingyuan, no matter how thoughtful her thoughts are and how sharp her methods are, is nothing more than a helpless boudoir woman, at his mercy.

Shen Jingshan looked magnanimous, stepped forward steadily, bowed and kowtowed, and every word was sonorous and powerful.

"Your Majesty is aware of this. The old case in your palace is an unjust case that has been unjust for more than ten years. Recently, all witnesses and material evidence have been collected, and it has been handed over to the government for handling in accordance with the law. The whole process has followed the rules and has never used power privately to disturb the situation of the court. XiaoThe daughter has vindicated her late mother and adhered to her true intentions. She has never interfered in the court.I have been an official for more than 30 years and have devoted myself to serving the public. I have never formed a party for personal gain or bent the law for personal gain.Your Majesty, please be aware of this."

Everything he said was truthful, clear-cut, and frank, but the prince's gang had already colluded with each other and spoke out to refute and confuse right and wrong. In an instant, arguments broke out in the court, and every sentence was deliberately smearing the Shen family.

Emperor Jing frowned slightly and his expression gradually darkened.

Just when the commotion was at its peak, a cold and deep voice suddenly sounded, instantly overpowering the noise in the hall.

"My lords' confusing remarks are too far-fetched."

Xiao Yuci walked slowly out of the clan queue. His black embroidered gold dragon court uniform made him tall and elegant, his brows and eyes were covered with a layer of frost, and his whole body was intimidating.He stood in the middle of the hall and glanced at the clamoring officials. With just one glance, everyone who had been chattering incessantly fell silent and lowered their heads, not daring to say a word.

Immediately afterwards, two secret guards in black bowed into the palace, holding a thick stack of neatly bound files, and laid them out beside the royal case in front of the palace.

"I have evidence to present." Xiao Yuci's voice was cold and cold, resounding throughout the entire Jinluan Palace. "This is all the records of the Eastern Palace's secret affairs with courtiers, secretly accepting local bribes, and private accumulation of dead men in the past six months. There is also ironclad evidence of the prince's personal letters delivering secret letters several times, manipulating officials, and deliberately framing important ministers during the period of confinement."
